## Description
Provide a clear summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue_number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature / MCP tool (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (updates to README, guides, or comments)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (latency improvements, caching)

- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
